response.message: Astra: Your latest plan says the full and reduced datasets should match in quantity. How does that fit the comparison you intended? Set the repeated checklist aside and examine what “fair” means in this LoRA study: which difference is deliberate, and which would undermine interpretation? Spend your attention on the distinction you find least settled, explaining why it matters rather than adding more controls.
response.rationale: Redirects repeated fairness lists toward a concrete design inconsistency and a reasoned choice of attention.
